summary: Ship all supported SeekTalent product packages with one verified WTSCLI runtime and extension pair.
rationale: Issue #431 extends the existing offline-distribution boundary to Windows x64, macOS arm64, and macOS Intel. Product builds prepare the pinned runtime and exact extension together, while user installs verify and atomically activate the pair without fetching browser components.
verification: uv run ruff check scripts/build_offline_macos_intel.py tests/test_build_offline_macos_intel.py tools/check_pr_governance.py tests/test_pr_governance.py
uv run ty check scripts/build_offline_macos_intel.py tools/check_pr_governance.py tests/test_build_offline_macos_intel.py tests/test_pr_governance.py
deletion_targets: User-side WTSCLI npm installation and separately supplied extension bundles
risks: A partial upgrade must never replace only the runtime, extension, manifest, Python prefix, or command shims.
A stale Chrome extension worker must remain visible and require an explicit extension reload or Chrome restart.
line_count_rationale: The existing oversized CLI remains the stable command registry and Workbench entrypoint. This slice adds one small browser-check command and a narrow Liepin-only disable path; environment classification and verification logic live in a focused module.
